decisive_items: estimated pulmonary arterial pressure of 60 mmHg
response.rationale: Right ventricular dilatation and elevated pulmonary artery pressure strongly indicate acute right heart strain, most consistent with pulmonary embolism; normal coronary arteries exclude ACS, and Takotsubo typically involves left ventricular apical dysfunction rather than isolated right heart strain.

rejected.why: Lacks typical left ventricular apical ballooning; right ventricular dilatation and pulmonary hypertension are not characteristic of Takotsubo.
Coronary angiography showed normal arteries without stenosis, directly contradicting acute coronary syndrome.
